meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用谷歌的 Cirq 框架为你编写和模拟量子电路，也可连接真实量子硬件运行，并支持噪声建模与参数扫描。
howto.when: 当你想用 Google 量子硬件，或要求设计考虑噪声的电路、做量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 创建一个含 H 门和 CNOT 门的线路，模拟 1000 次。
say.note: 会输出测量结果的统计直方图。

say.text: 用 Cirq 对参数 theta 做 0 到 2π 的线性扫描，取 20 个点。
say.note: 返回每个参数点的测量计数。

say.text: 用 Cirq 给线路添加去极化噪声，比较不同噪声水平下的输出。
say.note: 展示噪声对结果的影响。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Google's Cirq framework to write and simulate quantum circuits, run them on real quantum hardware, and handle noise modeling and parameter sweeps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to use Google quantum hardware, design noise-aware circuits, or run quantum characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Create a circuit with H and CNOT gates in Cirq and simulate 1000 times.
say_en.note: Shows a histogram of measurement results.

say_en.text: Sweep parameter theta from 0 to 2pi with 20 points in Cirq.
say_en.note: Returns counts for each parameter point.

say_en.text: Add depolarizing noise to a circuit in Cirq and compare outputs under different noise levels.
